description: Hourly electricity generation of Australian power plants, 2010-2019 (one series per plant) is a data set deposited in PANGAEA by its authors Maheshinderjeet Garg. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The repository holds 56 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 175296 data points. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-pangaea-repository.
